about: The override table's keys (docs/ui_api_2026-10.md section 3), in their order in the
block a wasm app hands over (native/moy_ui/moy_ui_api.h). tools/gen_os_table.py writes from it
moy_ui_over_keys.h (the keys, the flags words' bits, the table every tier's reader walks),
modmoy_ui_over.h (the board module's dict keys), runtime/toolkit/ui.py's _OVER_KEYS (the
host's block) and the doc's table.
kind: colour (a role's name or 0xRRGGBB), tri (true, false or absent), flag (true sets it),
wash (true, false, "view"), axis ("x"), int, index (Lua from 1), pair, quad, text, texts
(a list, NUL-joined). where: head (the nine words; id its text's length), hint (the word
after the id's text), flags (a bit of the first flags word, its words after the flags in
bit order), rows (a bit of the rows' word, behind the flags word's bit 25), flags2 (a bit of
the second flags word, bit 29). probe: the verb tests/test_ui_opts_seq.py draws it on,
with the keys `with` names beside it; example: the value it draws it with; unseen: a key
that probe draws no pixel of. A key with `doc` shares that key's row of the doc.

keys.value: a role name, or a colour `0xRRGGBB`
keys.does: replaces the kind's colour: a role (`"danger"`, `"value"`) still follows the theme and its mode; a raw colour is the app's own, and the readability check does not vouch for it
the id, where the label is not unique
the current mark, on a button or a part; false on a table of parts: no current mark of the table's
dimmed, no stop, never activates
the engine stops moving focus here (§4)
the engine draws no focus mark here (§4)
a slider draws a segment per step from `lo` to `hi`, the ones up to `v` filled, and no number
what an empty field shows, in the theme's disabled ink

true: a popover washes what it covers, as a dialog does: a row's or a card's menu (DESIGN.md, Menus and washes); `"view"`: a popover washes only the view its anchor lies in (the `ui.scroll` region `ui.at` was called in, else the page), leaving the anchor and its ring's reach (3 px at the scale) as drawn, so a chat's details tie to the one bubble and the rows outside the history stay bright; false: a dialog washes nothing, its page under it washed already (`docs/surface_model_v1.md` §14.5)
a table's first row is a verb (Notes' New note): its icon and words in `value`

on a page, a `ui.scroll` region, a card, a part or a dialog: what the app draws in it is a function of it (a field's text aside, which is the field's own), so a frame may shift its pixels or draw only its changed rows instead of drawing them (§2, Shift frames); the app moves it when what it draws changes. On a table of parts it keys the current row alone
a table's column 0 is a part `w` wide and its rows `h` tall (§2, A table of parts)
a table's current row wears the cursor bar
a table of parts' rows lie side by side (§2, A table of parts)

a table of parts' row 0 at the view's centre, its view resting on a row's centre. On `ui.page` or `ui.scroll`: the view shows whole units only -- a stacked row, a group's caption with its first row, each of a `ui.list`'s rows -- a unit the view's top cuts left out (its room stays the ground), and the first the foot cuts left out with everything after it, the band it leaves holding the "More below" cue (a down chevron and the words in the caption face's dim ink, `moy_str`'s `ui.more_below`); where the rows run on past the foot that band is a caption line and 4 px at least. A `ui.list`'s own label goes with its first row as a caption does. A view at rest off its units' tops (a drag let go, a fling or a wheel's glide spent) glides onto the nearest, its top or its foot, and a focus step scrolls it by whole units, its top landing on one (the engine keeps each snapping page's units as its last pass placed them, `moy_ui_tops_t`, MOY_UI_API_SNAPS pages of MOY_UI_API_TOPS). Nothing fades. A snapping view draws whole: it takes no `gen`
a table of parts' scroll is the app's
what a table's part may draw past its cell on every side, in px
a placed table of parts keeps its parts across frames: what every part is a function of beside its row's cells; below 0 it keeps nothing of this frame's paint

keys.value: `(x, y, w, h)` (Lua `{x, y, w, h}`)
keys.does: a rect drawn over a kept table after its pass this frame (a cursor); `w` or `h` 0: none
a kept table of parts draws its view whole this frame (the app drew its ground anew)
a table of parts' rows hold parts across: a row's cells are its parts' keys, the first `first` px into the view across the rows' axis, each `pitch` px on from the last
with `across`: the current row's part its `gen` and marks belong to
a table of parts' ground is the same along its axis, so a frame whose buffer lacks the table at its scroll may move the view out of the buffer the last frame painted
px of a table of parts' view end along its axis the app blends after its parts (a move carries blended pixels: they draw again)
an info's or a link's signal glyph before its value: four bars, that many lit (`ui.bubble`'s glyph)
a list's secondary text a row, at its right in the dim ink
a list's `check` icon in `value` at its current row's right, its column kept on every row

a list's rows are two-line, each sub the row's caption line under its title (its item), the row's `values` entry its time at the title's right in the caption face's dim ink; 34 px on the handheld, 44 under the tap floor, 42 on the desk, at the scale; in a group a rule heads each row
a two-line row's lead: an icon in `value`, or `"@"` and a person's name: their initials (two at most) in the caption face's `value` on a `surface_alt` disc (a light look's `panel`)

keys.value: a list of text or numbers
keys.does: a two-line row's badge at the right of its caption line: `value` under `value_ink`, ends round; `""` or 0 none. A row with one draws its title in `value` and its caption line in `ink`
a pill after a two-line row's title: the caption face's dim ink in a 1 px `border` ring (`"Public"`)
an icon after a two-line row's title in the dim ink (`"lock"`), where its tag is empty

`ui.group("", o)`: a group with no caption (an empty caption without it ends one), drawn as a card on every console: on the desk its rows inset as a handheld's are, a 1 px `border` ring with the card's radius a pixel round them and the rules between them (a captioned group's rows on the desk have the rules alone)
an info's or a link's tag at its value's right (a link's: before its chevron): the caption face's dim ink in a 1 px `border` pill, a caption line and 2 px tall, the words 5 px in (`"Public"`)
a dialog opens on its button of that label

on `ui.page` or `ui.scroll` (the block's second word of flags, bit 0): the view opens at its foot and stays there as its rows grow while it rests there (a chat's history, a log); scrolled up, it stays where it was put until it is back at its foot. Under `snap`, while rows lie above its scroll, the gap its top leaves holds the "Older messages" cue (an up chevron and `moy_str`'s `ui.older`, as the foot's), the top unit giving way where that gap is shorter than the caption face's ascent and 2 px; no cue while a popover is up
a field draws a `*` for each character of its text, never the text (a password); what it answers is the text as typed
